云端老师 · web-teacher

Provide shared methods for course material, teaching, learning paths, and learning spaces.

Install in Codex ↗ GitHub source

When to use it

Share teaching methods with local-teacher. The recipient supplies their own learning records and materials.

“Use this Skill for my task, first checking the companion methods and actual tools it needs.”

What is included

Includes the method and configuration guidance. The package README specifies resources, scripts, companion Skills, and external tools. Install relevant companions and bind your own environment.

Install in Codex

Open the installation page and copy the request to Codex. It installs the complete package from the boluopai marketplace, without manual ZIP extraction.

Get installation request ↗

Ask naturally; if the client supports explicit invocation, select web-teacher。The client’s existing authority, authentication, and tool boundaries remain in force.
